s-1.ptxt: Basic Inspection (Check JEITA Standard Error Codes)

s2.ptxt: Check Toll Collection (ETC) Computer Assembly Startup

s3.ptxt: Check that the green indicator and amber indicator illuminate for 5 seconds.
Check that the startup check ends normally and the indicators go off.

atten4.ptxt: If there is a malfunction in the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly, the amber indicator blinks, the multi-display voice gives the notification "Bong. A malfunction has occurred in the ETC. ETC cannot be used", and the JEITA standard error code is displayed on the multi-display. (see )

atten3.ptxt: The multi-display does not give guidance until 20 seconds or more have elapsed after the ignition switch is turned to ACC.

s3.ptxt: The multi-display voice gives the notification "Beep", the green indicator of the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly starts blinking, and card authentication starts.
Check that the multi-display voice gives the notification "Bong. The ETC card has been inserted" (*) and the green indicator of the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly illuminates.

item.ptxt: If there is a problem with the ETC card, the amber indicator of the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly blinks and a warning sound is emitted. The warning sound continues until the card is removed. Also, the multi-display voice gives the notification "Bong. Cannot read card. Please check the card", and the JEITA standard error code is displayed on the multi-display. (see )

*: Depending on the expiration date of the inserted card, the multi-display voice gives the notification "Bong. The ETC card expires at the end of this month. Please check the card" or "Bong. The ETC card has expired".

atten4.ptxt: The following information of the toll collection (ETC) computer assembly can be checked by displaying it on the navigation receiver assembly display.

s3.ptxt: Press the "Info G" switch to display the information screen.
Press "Display Registration Information" on the ETC menu screen.

atten4.ptxt: The screen is an example display and may differ from the actual screen.

s3.ptxt: Check the on-board unit management number.

table.title: On-board Unit Management Number Display Content

item.ptxt: The on-board unit management number is displayed as "XXXXX - XXXXXXXX - XXXXXX" (X is a number from 0 to 9).
Record this display content on the customer problem analysis sheet.

s3.ptxt: Check the on-board unit registration number.

table.title: On-board Unit Registration Number Display Content

atten4.ptxt: The on-board unit registration number is displayed as "XXX - XXXXXXXX" (X is a number from 0 to 9).

s3.ptxt: Check the setup card issue date.

atten4.ptxt: If the on-board unit has not been set up, " Year Month Day" is displayed.

s3.ptxt: Check the setup card information expiration date.

atten4.ptxt: If the on-board unit has not been set up and the expiration date (*) of the setup card information has not been set, " Year Month Day" is displayed. (*: Not the expiration date of the ETC card)

item.ptxt: The most recently occurring JEITA standard error code is displayed.

The toll collection (ETC) computer assembly stores the 1 most recently occurring JEITA standard error code, and this error code is displayed. Therefore, even if an error code is displayed, it does not necessarily indicate the current system condition.

s-1.ptxt: Check Latest Stored JEITA Standard Error Codes

s2.ptxt: Check by Toll Collection (ETC) Computer Assembly Voice Guidance

s3.ptxt: Remove the ETC card and turn the ignition switch to ACC.
When the "History" switch is pressed for 2 seconds or more, the latest JEITA standard error code is announced.

item.ptxt: The most recently occurring JEITA standard error code is announced.

The toll collection (ETC) computer assembly stores the 1 most recently occurring JEITA standard error code, and this error code is displayed. Therefore, even if an error code is displayed, it does not necessarily indicate the current system condition.

s-1.ptxt: Clear Stored JEITA Standard Error Codes

s3.ptxt: Press the "History" switch and "VOL UP" switch simultaneously for 2 seconds or more to clear the JEITA standard error code.
